runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 07:23 sweep genuinely searched Profesia, direct-company career indexes, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress-oriented discovery, Upwork freelance discovery, Reddit/public WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit passed ranking plus language/skill gates. Wolt Support Associate is Bratislava-local but requires minimum B2 English; Nexcess Technical Support Engineer is Bratislava/remote-friendly but requires Linux terminal knowledge and deeper networking; Sharp Brains L1 desktop support is Bratislava onsite B2B/freelance but does not clearly beat existing LIVE support roles. SPP Administrátor lokálneho centra údržby is a strong BA admin/technical candidate at 1400-1800 EUR with SAP, documentation and driver-B fit, but asks minimum 2 years similar experience, so it remains below automatic promotion threshold. Upwork surfaced Worldwide WordPress roles, but visible fresh jobs were low-budget, development-heavy, portfolio-heavy or geographically restricted. Facebook yielded 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts with direct links.
